audit.whatIsWrong: The packet flags this directly: 'level chart contradicts data: Galio wins only 46.55% but the chart gives Galio 4/7 stages vs 1'. The prose runs Galio-favoured from Level 2 all the way through the first item — whys[5] still says 'close the all-in now' at the first-item row — while the on-disk chart in both layers says the opposite at those rows (Skill, Vladimir, Vladimir, Skill, Skill, Vladimir, Vladimir). Neither version is right.
audit.why: The prose is correct that Galio owns the early lane and wrong about how long it lasts; the chart is correct that Vladimir owns the late game and wrong about the early. Galio loses this matchup on average, so the honest chart gives him the levels his kit actually wins and hands the item rows back.
audit.corrected: Skill, Galio, Galio, Galio, Skill, Vladimir, Vladimir — three rows to Galio, two shared, two to Vladimir, which fits 46.55%.
sources: scratchpad packet galio.json entry vladimir (46.55%, 58 games; defect: level chart contradicts data)
champ-data/content/galio.js (mid: 'This is your best stretch'; late: 'this is his game now')

audit.whatIsWrong: 'Bait Sanguine Pool — once it is down it is on a long cooldown' appears in mid, wants.you[1], whys[3] and spikes[0], and the number is never given. Hemoplague is called 'his ultimate' in phases[4].why and never named or explained in the content layer at all.
audit.why: Sanguine Pool is 28/25/22/19/16 — 28 seconds at rank 1 is one of the longest defensive cooldowns in the top lane, and it is the whole reason Galio's level 2-5 window exists. Tides of Blood is 13s at rank 1 dropping to 5s, and Hemoplague is a flat 120s that amplifies the damage he takes and heals him for each champion hit, which is the real reason Level 6 is not a free Galio row.
audit.corrected: Sanguine Pool 28s at rank 1; Tides of Blood 13s dropping to 5s; Hemoplague a flat 120s. Bait the Pool and you own the next 28 seconds.
sources: champ-data/_kits/vladimir.json (W 28/25/22/19/16; E 13/11/9/7/5; R cooldown 120, 'Affected enemies take increased damage... heals Vladimir for each enemy Champion hit')

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[2].why says 'the dash is interruptible and root-able mid-flight', and dontsFull[0] says 'E-punch into his Sanguine Pool (it catches you mid-dash)'.
audit.why: Vladimir has no root, no knockup and no interrupt anywhere in his kit — Tides of Blood and Sanguine Pool slow, and that is the whole of his crowd control. The Pool cannot catch you: it makes Vladimir untargetable for 2 seconds. The cost of punching into it is not being caught, it is spending a 0.75-second knockup and an 18-second taunt on a target that no longer exists.
audit.corrected: Sanguine Pool does not catch you — it deletes the target for 2 seconds. Punching into it wastes the knockup and the taunt, so bait it out and punch in the 28 seconds after.
sources: champ-data/_kits/vladimir.json (W Sanguine Pool: 'becoming untargetable for 2 seconds', flags slow,untargetable; no root/knockup in kit)
wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Galio (Justice Punch cannot be interrupted mid-travel)

audit.whatIsWrong: Tides of Blood is described only as poke you should absorb. Nothing says it can be blocked.
audit.why: Riot's own text says the released reservoir 'can be blocked by enemy units'. Standing behind your own minions turns his main poke tool — a 13-second-to-5-second ability he pays health for — into nothing. In a lane whose Galio plan is 'farm and hold your window', that is the single cheapest way to hold it.
audit.corrected: Tides of Blood is blocked by units, so last-hit with a minion between you and him and his poke does nothing while he still pays the health cost.
sources: champ-data/_kits/vladimir.json (E Tides of Blood: 'deals damage in the area around him but can be blocked by enemy units')

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[1] and wants.you[1] both say Sanguine Pool 'dodges your Hero's Entrance', with no timing attached.
audit.why: Hero's Entrance channels 2.75 seconds before it lands, and Sanguine Pool is untargetable for only 2 seconds. Vladimir cannot pre-empt the landing by pooling when he sees the channel start — 2 seconds of untargetability does not cover a 2.75-second channel — he has to hold the Pool for the landing itself. That is a real, usable timing detail and the entry currently teaches the opposite lesson.
audit.corrected: Hero's Entrance takes 2.75 seconds to land and Sanguine Pool lasts 2 — he cannot pool on the channel and still be gone when you arrive, so he must hold it, which means it is spent the moment you land.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[0].why and breakdown.early both credit 'your passive shield' with blanking his chip.
audit.why: Galio's passive is Colossal Smash, an empowered basic attack — not a shield. The magic shield is Shield of Durand's own passive, 7.5/9/10.5/12/13.5% of maximum health, and it only comes back after 12/10/8 seconds without taking damage. Against a champion whose whole plan is constant Transfusion chip, that recharge condition almost never triggers in lane, so naming the right source changes the advice from 'free' to 'spend it deliberately'.
audit.corrected: The magic shield is Shield of Durand's passive, not Galio's — 7.5% of max health at rank 1, and it only recharges after 12 seconds untouched, which a Transfusion every 9 seconds denies.
sources: wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Galio (W passive shield 7.5/9/10.5/12/13.5% max health, restores after 12/10/8s without taking damage)

audit.why: report Itemization already carries 'Oblivion Orb early — his healing fights your trade math', which is the right answer to Transfusion and Hemoplague. _missing-interactions.json flags needs-antiheal for exactly those two abilities. The content layer omits it, so the fix goes there.

The packet flags "E's Justice Punch", "Shield of Durand's" and "Use Hero's Entrance" as probable wrong ability names. All three are false positives from the near-miss matcher — the names are correct. The 'shield eats his magic' framing is also right here and now has a number: 25% at rank 1 rising to 45% against magic.
46.55% over 58 games. EVEN at 6/10 is a fair label for a lane Galio wins early and loses late; only the stage chart needed reconciling.

notes: Galio facts verified at wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Galio and reused across this slice: Shield of Durand cuts magic 25/30/35/40/45% and physical exactly half (12.5/15/17.5/20/22.5%); its passive is a magic shield of 7.5/9/10.5/12/13.5% max health restoring after 12/10/8s (by level) without taking damage; taunt on release, radius 175-350, 0.5-1.5s by channel time. Justice Punch knocks up 0.75s, cannot be interrupted mid-travel, is disabled while Grounded, halts on terrain or champions. Winds of War 825, tornado 2s, no slow. Hero's Entrance channels 2.75s, CC-immune after 1.25s, gives allies the W magic shield for 5s. Colossal Smash is a 5s empowered auto scaling with 60% bonus MR.
